summary: Shackleton Base is a heavy worker-placement game from Fabio Lopiano in the style of his earlier Merv and On Mars, where players fund lunar corporations and build up bases while managing tightly interlocking resource chains. Like his other designs, the appeal is in optimizing an efficient sequence of actions and timing across multiple asymmetric corporation modules.
praised: high replayability from randomized corporation modules
criticised: heavy rules and setup for a first play
similar complexity fatigue to the designer's other games

interaction.kind: worker placement blocking and area majority
interaction.detail: Players compete for limited worker-placement spots and area-majority positions on the shared base, so timing and blocking opponents from key actions matters, while most engine-building happens on individual player boards.

scoring.how_you_win: Place workers over a fixed number of rounds to build structures, win area-majority bonuses, and complete corporation projects and contracts; the highest accumulated VP at the end wins.

similar: Merv: The Heart of the Silk Road
_name: Shackleton Base: A Journey to the Moon
